description: Full-text search over the published pages of the i22 website. Returns matching pages with title, URL and short description. Terms are OR-linked; use a few precise words (at most 200 characters). Read a hit with i22_ai_page_read before answering from it. Retrieval needs no personal data; do not include any in queries.

title: Search the i22 website
